gen-dafont-conthrax-roboto-slab: Bent tubing, basically: Conthrax stands its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Roboto Slab sits lower and more structured, its open throats keeping the line moving like one thread.
gen-dafont-cowboys-fs-epilogue: Cowboys traces every letter in one laser-etched line, leaving wide gaps between neighboring stems. And Epilogue handles the friendly side, curvy and wire-like, with a tall lowercase that feels approachable.
gen-dafont-cowboys-manrope: Rustic and authoritative, Cowboys traces its letters with wide gaps between stems. What stands out is Manrope's approachable pen line, whose width never changes, and the bright open mouths on every curve.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-fauna-one: Raw and chaotic, Disorder spaces its big lowercase well apart. Fauna One steps in with shallow ascenders and a generous e, so the loud heading gets a dignified, literary partner.
gen-dafont-disorder-mulish: Mulish has no stroke modulation at all, and its apertures open like the end of a horseshoe magnet. Make Disorder small and its widely spaced glyphs start to scatter loosely.
gen-dafont-disorder-rubik: Disorder has zero stroke modulation and a high x-height, so its lowercase looks big and its glyphs sit well apart. Rubik's soft, open round letters stay clear at small sizes.
gen-dafont-dogica-bitter: Heavy and commanding, Dogica pushes its lowercase close to capital height and spaces everything out with wide tracking. Bitter feels grounded beside it, dependable and open in every s.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-epunda-slab: Commanding and heavy, Dogica stretches wide tracking across lowercase that rises close to the capitals, every curve ending open. Epunda Slab brings a dignified, gaping c and tall rounded forms.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-kadwa: Heavy and commanding, Dogica runs on wide tracking and near-capital lowercase height. Kadwa does the quieter editorial work, with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height carrying the text steadily.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-suwannaphum: Wide-set and loud, Dogica lifts its lowercase close to the capitals. Suwannaphum supplies the strongest link, a dignified body whose bent-paperclip c and high, squared-off x-height echo that bulk.
